reason: I get one group a week, Booking and Airbnb already send my check-in and Wi-Fi messages for free, and the few real questions I answer myself on WhatsApp anyway. Paying €150 plus €35 a month to answer what my house manual already says doesn't add up for one villa.
objection: If the AI tells a guest something wrong about the pool, parking or check-out, I'm the one who eats the 8 instead of a 10 on Booking. My score is worth more to me than saving a few messages.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing other villa owners on this coast whose Booking scores went up with it, and dropping the €150 setup so I can test it for a full season with no money down.
